column1: # M17-bench-series-T6 (D-0256). The per-node factor lane's PLAN: one line per instance,
# TAB-separated, read by scripts/factor_lane.sh. Files are under bench/factor/fzn/.
#   id      the instance's name in every table
#   family  the geometric mean is taken per family
#   blimit  BAGUETTE_NODE_LIMIT for every baguette run (0: to the end of the search)
#   ref     the reference solver: gecode (fzn-gecode -s) or chuffed-nolazy (fzn-chuffed -s
#           --restart none --lazy off, Chuffed without explanations or learning)
#   rlimit  the reference's budget: gecode -node N, chuffed -t N milliseconds (0: none)
#   bfzn    baguette's flattening      rfzn   the reference's flattening
# The first six lines are D-0207's instances and budgets (its section 2), the files it flattened
# on 2026-11-23, unchanged: the comparison with its table is on the same bytes. The reference is
# the one D-0207 aligned the tree with. rcpsp11_60's same tree is Chuffed --lazy off's (Gecode's
# cumulative adds edge-finding and closes in 17 nodes); rcpsp11_66 has no same tree with any
# reference that finishes (Chuffed --lazy off runs past 60 s), so its reference is Gecode's own
# tree cut at 20 000 nodes and the lane compares it per FAILURE.
# The sat3 lines are the planted 3-SAT family (gen_3sat.py 200 4.26 SEED, seeds 1 to 3, all
# three kept), at a budget of 20 000 nodes on both sides.
# Longest first: the lane starts the lines in this order.
